_doc: Seconds each step of .github/workflows/pages.yml may take, keyed 'job/step name'. tools/step_budgets.py check-run fails the build job's last step on a step over its budget or with no row; tools/test_step_budgets.sh fails on a step with no row, and on a step that reads the whole corpus without naming the cache it restores ('cache'), how it limits itself to what changed ('incremental'), or why it can do neither ('uncached'). Raise a budget only with the reason in the commit: a budget that moves with every slowdown catches nothing.

build/Check out.note: was 120 with actions/checkout fetching the whole ~1GB tree every run (66s, run 38370347047). Now an incremental fetch on the cached store (tools/test_ci_checkout.sh): 6s warm (run 38380967725); a cold store is the old ~63s full fetch and goes over, once

build/Build the authored puzzle.note: 2s on a warm clue index (run 38378765553); 31s cold, which the explicit Save the clue index now prevents

build/Build the puzzle shims and reindex.note: 17-21s on warm shims and rows (runs 38378765553, 38385076152); 56-127s cold (127s in run 38390532020). Was 75, under that cold range: an edit to code the index rows reach (convert_v2, run 38383021945) re-makes all ~51k rows by design and took 94s, so every such push went red for expected work

build/Draw the social cards.note: was 900: the card key hashed make_og_card.py's bytes, so any edit redrew all ~17k cards 600 a run (816s, run 38370347047). Now keyed on the card's rendered HTML: steady state is the cached list (~15-40s) plus the cards a push moved; worst case a code edit re-lists every row (~60s) and draws OG_LIMIT=120 cards at ~0.9s each

build/Generate the crawlable pages.note: a code or data change re-renders every puzzle page (tools/page_cache.py's fingerprint); a puzzle push re-renders the pages whose inputs moved

build/List the site.uncached: lists the published files by glob; it opens none of them
build/List the site.note: globs PUBLISH and writes the tar list. Was Stage the site, 45s: 23s hard-linking ~138k files into _site/ and 22s checking links (run 38385716791)

build/Start the site checks.uncached: starts the checks Wait for the site checks collects, and returns
build/Start the site checks.note: only starts the link check and the IndexNow hashing in the background; their time shows in Wait for the site checks

build/Upload the site.note: 39s at deflate level 1 (run 38378765553), 65s at level 6; stored (level 0) 18s (run 38380967725)

build/Wait for the site checks.uncached: the link check reads every published page (stage_site.py --check, across the cores) and IndexNow hashes them; they run beside Archive and Upload, so this is only what is left over
build/Wait for the site checks.note: was the check half of Stage the site (22s) plus List the changed pages (8s), in series in front of the upload

build/Wait for the annotation check.note: zero unless validate is still running when the build is ready, which only a full check does: validate then takes ~345s and the build reaches this step at ~190s since the cached checkout (124s in run 38380967725). Was 120 when the build was slower; covers a full check at its 300s budget

build/Deploy to Pages.note: GitHub side: 69-87s for the 2.5GB, ~138k-file artifact (runs 38385076152, 38385716791, 38383021945); scales with what is shipped, not with what changed

build/Save the puzzle pages.note: runs only after a render of over 2000 pages (a code change, a cold cache)

validate/Choose what to check.note: a full check fetches the whole tree here, in four streams; the diff and the scope are a few seconds

validate/Check every annotation.note: the same full check took 107s, 160s, 219s and 217s on four runs on 2026-10-13 (runner noise; the scoped check has its own row): 300 covers that spread, so only a real slowdown goes red
validate/Check every annotation.uncached: the nightly and rule-change full check, spread across the runner's cores (validate_annotations.check_all); its budget is the alarm that it needs a bigger runner or a cache

validate/Trim the CodeQL caches.note: 16s for the first 204 deletions, by hand on 2026-10-13; a few a run after that

validate/Check the changed annotations.incremental: only the puzzle files changed since the last successfully deployed commit (Choose what to check)
